Hash recorded before the block was printed. Fixed in f82925ff: recorded only after a successful stdout write.
Doc comment contradicted the suppression. Fixed in f82925ff.
Verifier advisory: the store did not separate sources, so one source silenced another for the same session id. Fixed in f82925ff: keyed by source and session.
